jobs.description: JustPlay is looking for a (Senior) Finance Controller (all genders) to join our growing Finance team. Cost control: Build levers and tracking for the largest cost blocks: personnel, SaaS, cloud, consulting, and payment fees (PayPal, FX). Analysis: Run variance analysis against budget, forecast and weekly flash, build scenario models, and prepare quarterly business reviews.
